formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∃ (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x3 ++ [x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]) ≠ x1.eval (List.ofFn x3 ++ [x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ))])) → (∃ (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x4 ++ [x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]) ≠ x1.eval (List.ofFn x4 ++ [Bool.false])) → (∀ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x5 ++ [x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]) = (x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) → (∀ x6 ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (3 : ℕ)], (List.filter (fun (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => [x6, (9 : ℕ)].any fun (x9 : ℕ) => (if x8.op.eval [Bool.false] = Bool.true then List.take (1 : ℕ) x8.inputs else x8.inputs).contains x9) x1.gates).length ≤ (2 : ℕ)) → (15 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: Petersen graph minus a vertex as in the parent, F its edge function: an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit on 10 inputs that computes F with its tenth input fed x0 AND x3, whose function changes somewhere when that input is fed x4 AND x6 instead and somewhere when it is fed false, and in which for each of v = 0 and v = 3 at most 2 gates read input v or wire 9 (a NOT at its first input only), has at least 15 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_3) computes its edge function
